title: next surfaces a session's recorded coordination obligations without an implementation claim (design)
outcome: next surfaces a session's recorded coordination obligations without an implementation claim (design)
acceptance: a coordinator or reviewer session that holds no claim sees on next the obligations it recorded or was assigned (review parent, owed note or gate, pending handoff) as a distinct section; evaluated against ordinary coordination items first; no new role or watch system unless the evaluation shows one is needed

completion.summary: Claimless resume discovery implemented and documented to the accepted design, all correction children and gates complete, independent review closed.
